zh.title: GLM 可以正常调用工具
zh.description: 通过中转使用 GLM 时，读文件、改文件等操作不再因格式问题报错中断

zh.title: 很长的命令也能运行
zh.description: 模型把整段脚本写进一条命令时，Windows 上不再启动失败

zh.title: 重试时不再误报失败
zh.description: 网络或限流出错后自动重试期间只显示重试提示；连续失败会停下并说明原因，不再无休止重试

zh.title: 过程中的失败提示更轻
zh.description: 任务还在进行时，中途的操作失败只显示一行提示；后台命令失败不再显示内部报错

en.title: GLM can use tools
en.description: Reading and editing files with GLM through a gateway no longer stops on a format error

en.title: Very long commands run
en.description: A command that carries a whole script no longer fails to start on Windows

en.title: Retries no longer look like failures
en.description: While a network or rate-limit error is retried you see a retry hint; repeated failures stop with an explanation instead of retrying without end

en.title: Quieter mid-task failures
en.description: A failed step in a running task shows one line; a failed background command no longer shows internal errors
